task_text: Hand the cream cheese stick over to the other side: pick it up with the right arm, pass it to the other gripper and put it down on the left (+y) half. Success: the cream cheese stick's centre is at least 0.10 m past the middle line between the two arms, on the left arm's side, no more than 0.10 m above the table top, and over the table (the hand-over itself is not checked). The goal must hold for 30 consecutive control steps (1.02 s); the episode then ends in success.
